chunks: 33 - and with the chain of narration the first from Ali son of Mahzyar, from al-Hasan son of Mahboob, from Malik son of Atiyya, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali he said:

not I heard of anyone from among the people who was more ascetic than Ali son of al-Husayn upon them both be peace except what reached me about Ali son of son of Abi Talib blessings of Allah upon him. then said Abu Hamza: was Ali son of al-Husayn upon them both be peace whenever he spoke about asceticism, and admonished he made weep those who in his presence. said Abu Hamza: so I read a page/document in it the words of asceticism from the words of Ali son of al-Husayn upon them both be peace so I copied what was in it, and I brought it to him with it, and I presented it to him, and he recognized it and confirmed it and there was in it:
in the name of Allah the Most Merciful the Most Compassionate may He suffice us Allah and for you the plotting of the oppressors, and the rancor of the envious, and the might of the tyrants.

O believers your affliction is the tyrants from among the people of desire for this world , those inclined towards it, those tempted by it, those who come upon upon it and upon its chaff/debris the lifeless and its dry straw the perishing tomorrow , so beware of what He cautioned you Allah from it, and detach yourselves from what He enjoined you to renounce Allah in it from it, and do not incline to what in this world like the inclining of one who has taken it an abode of permanence and a place of settlement, and by Allah indeed for you from what in it about it sufficient evidence from its adornment , and the changing of its days, and the fluctuation of its upheavals and its exemplary punishments , and its playing with its people. surely it raises the lowly and brings down the noble, and it sends to the Fire nations/peoples tomorrow, so in this a lesson and a test and a deterrent for the cautious . surely the affairs that come upon you in every day and night of the misleading trials , and the occurrences of innovations, and the patterns of injustice, and the calamities of the age, and the awe of the rulers, and the whispers of Satan serve to repel the hearts from their awakening , and to distract them from the existing guidance , and the recognition of the people of the truth except a few of those whom has protected Allah, and none knows the changing of its days , and the fluctuation of its conditions, and the end of the harm of its temptation except one whom has protected him Allah, and walked the path of right guidance, and taken the path of temperance among those who sought help for that through asceticism, and he persistently engaged in reflection , and drew lessons from the happenings and was deterred, and renounced in the fleeting allure of the world, and turned away from its pleasures , and yearned for the lasting bliss of the Hereafter , and strove for it its due striving, and kept watch over death, and grew weary of life with the people the oppressive

, then at that point he looks upon what in the world with an eye sharp penetrating of sight and perceives the events of trials, and the misguidance of innovations, and the tyranny of the kings the oppressive. indeed by my soul you have experienced [from] the affairs the past in the days the bygone of the trials the accumulated and the immersion in them that which you can deduce by it to avoiding the despots and the partisans of innovations and transgression and corruption on the earth without right. so seek help from Allah, and return to the obedience of Allah, and the obedience of the one who he is most worthy of obedience rather than those who have been followed and obeyed . so take precaution the precaution before before the remorse and the distress, and the coming before Allah, and standing before His hands. and by Allah not proceeded a people ever from disobedience to Allah except to His punishment, and not preferred a people ever this world over the Hereafter except evil was their path and evil was their destination. and not knowledge of Allah and acting in obedience to Him but two intimate companions inseparable, [so] whoever knows Allah fears Him, and that prompts him the fear to act in obedience to Allah. and indeed the people of knowledge and their followers those who recognized Allah and acted for Him and inclined towards Him, and indeed said Allah the Exalted: " only fear Allah among His servants the knowledgeable " . so do not seek anything of what in this world through disobedience to Allah, and occupy yourselves in this world with obedience to Allah, and seize its days, and strive for what in it your salvation tomorrow from the punishment of Allah, for indeed that the least of obligation, and the nearest to the excuse, and the most hopeful

for salvation. so put forward the command of Allah and His obedience and the obedience of those whom has made obligatory Allah his obedience before all of affairs all of them, and do not put forward the affairs that come upon you from the tyrants, of the temptations of the flourish of the world before the hands of the command of Allah and His obedience and the obedience of those with authority from among you. and know that you and we servants of Allah , will judge over us and over you a Master Judge tomorrow, and that is your standing place and your place of questioning, so prepare the answer before the halt and the questioning and the presentation before the Lord of the worlds, on that Day not shall speak a soul except by His leave . and know that Allah the Exalted will not confirm on that Day a liar, nor will He belie the truthful, nor will He reject the excuse of one justified, nor will He excuse the one without justification, rather He has the conclusive proof over His creation through the Messengers and through the Successors after the Messengers. so fear Allah O servants of Allah, and set about to reforming yourselves and obedience to Allah and obedience to those whom He placed you under in it, perhaps one who regrets [and] has already regretted over what has neglected in the past regarding the rights of Allah, and wasted of the rights of Allah , so seek forgiveness from Allah and turn in repentance to Him, for indeed He accepts repentance, and pardons from sins, and knows what

you do. and beware of the company of the sinners , and aiding the oppressors, and being close to the transgressors, be cautious of their temptation, and keep your distance from their domain, and know that he who opposes the servants of Allah, and adopts other than the religion of Allah, and stubbornly follows his own will against the command of the guardian of is in a fire that blazes, that devours bodies that have departed from them their souls and overwhelmed upon them their wretchedness, so they are dead not feeling the heat of the fire so take heed O people of insight, and praise Allah for what He guided you, and know that you cannot escape from the power of Allah to any other power, and Allah shall soon see Allah your deeds then unto Him you shall be gathered, so benefit from the admonition, and adopt the manners of the righteous.

key_terms.أُولِي الْأَمْرِ: Those in authority; in Shia theology, specifically refers to the divinely appointed Imams from the Prophet's household
key_terms.التَّوْبَة: Repentance; sincere return to God after committing sins, accompanied by remorse and resolve not to repeat
key_terms.الزُّهْد: Asceticism; detachment from worldly pleasures and material possessions for the sake of God
key_terms.الطَّاغُوت: Tyrant or false god; one who transgresses all bounds in claiming authority that belongs to God alone
key_terms.الْآخِرَة: The hereafter; the permanent abode after death where souls are held accountable for their earthly deeds

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Sajjad teach about asceticism, worldly detachment, and preparing for the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: Abu Hamza al-Thumali narrates that he had not heard of anyone more ascetic than Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (Sajjad), peace be upon him, except for Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib. The Imam's discourses on asceticism and piety would move all present to tears. Abu Hamza obtained a written document of the Imam's teachings, which the Imam verified and confirmed. The document is a powerful ethical exhortation warning believers against worldly attachment, the tyranny of unjust rulers, and the temptations of this fleeting life. Imam Sajjad urges believers to seek knowledge of God, obey Him and His appointed authorities, prepare for the Day of Judgment, repent sincerely, avoid the company of sinners and oppressors, and recognize that true success lies in the hereafter, not in this transient world.
